scenarioDefs.name: Irrigation
scenarioDefs.brief: The basin on the right is dry. Open the reservoir and fill the basin with water.

scenarioDefs.name: Lava crossing
scenarioDefs.brief: Drain the reservoir into the cistern under the floor (open its wooden hatch), without letting the water touch the lava.

scenarioDefs.name: Demolition
scenarioDefs.brief: A wall of ice holds back the lake. Blow a hole in it and flood the basin.

scenarioDefs.name: Firebreak
scenarioDefs.brief: Lightning has set the east end of the wood alight, and the wind is carrying it west. Stop the fire before it reaches the west wood.

scenarioDefs.name: Green the valley
scenarioDefs.brief: Nothing grows on the sand. Make soil, water it, and sow seeds a little apart to get four trees growing in the valley.

goals.label: Trees 16+ cells tall in the valley

scenarioDefs.name: Flood defence
scenarioDefs.brief: The river is about to burst its banks, and the town sits at the bottom of the valley. Keep the water out of the town until the flood passes: the old quarry up on the hill could hold a lot of it.

scenarioDefs.name: Volcano
scenarioDefs.brief: The volcano is erupting and the lava is heading for the village. Put it out: water quenches lava to a crust of rock. Crust over every bit of lava, and cap the crater so no more wells up.

scenarioDefs.name: Desert bloom
scenarioDefs.brief: Water sinks straight through desert sand, and the sun dries soil four times as fast as in the hills. Line beds in the flat pans between the dunes with clay to hold the water, cover them with soil, and grow six trees.

scenarioDefs.name: Hold the hillside
scenarioDefs.brief: A storm is coming, and the farm sits at the foot of a steep hill of soil. Soaked through, the slope will slide. Terrace it and plant it before the rain, and keep the farm from being buried.

scenarioDefs.name: Lightning rod
scenarioDefs.brief: A thunderstorm is building over the village at the end of a dry summer, and its huts are tinder. Lightning goes for the highest point near it, and metal most of all: give it something better to hit.

scenarioDefs.name: Bridge the gorge
scenarioDefs.brief: At the half-minute the quarrymen will tip a cartload of sand out over the middle of the gorge. Bridge it so the load stays up out of the river. A long plank sags and snaps under its own weight: the old bridge's footings are still there to build on.

scenarioDefs.name: Brickworks
scenarioDefs.brief: The brickworks bakes its clay on a lava seep: clay laid on lava fires into brick at 600°, but only where the heat reaches it. Fire 150 bricks out of 200 clay.

scenarioDefs.name: Rabbit plague
scenarioDefs.brief: The rabbits have had a good year, and they are eating the meadow down to the soil. Bring in foxes to thin them out, but a meadow needs its rabbits too: keep the grass alive and at least twenty rabbits.

scenarioDefs.name: Dry pond
scenarioDefs.brief: The stream that fed the pond has dried up, and the summer sun will drink what is left within the minute. Keep water standing in the pond, and its reeds alive, to the end of the dry season. You have just enough water if you ration it: the pond only holds so much, and what spills over soaks into the parched ground.

scenarioDefs.name: Wildfire season
scenarioDefs.brief: Dry thunderstorms are coming over the forest at the end of the summer. Keep six of the eight trees standing until the rains.
